# smbCloud

> smbCloud is an SSH-first cloud deploy platform for small teams. It helps developers deploy Node.js, Ruby on Rails, and Swift/Vapor apps with one command, live logs, fast rollbacks, and a clean web console.

Website: https://smbcloud.xyz/
Organization: smbCloud
Company: Splitfire AB
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Contact: support@smbcloud.xyz
GitHub: https://github.com/smbcloudXYZ

## Core topics
- SSH-first application deployment
- Node.js deployment
- Ruby on Rails deployment
- Swift Vapor deployment
- Developer infrastructure for small teams
- Hosted deploy workflows, logs, and rollbacks

## Products and services
- smbCloud Deploy: application deployment over SSH
- smbCloud Auth: hosted authentication flows
- smbCloud Mail: domain mail routing and inbox workflows
- GresIQ: data layer service within the smbCloud platform
- siGit Code & Deploy: mobile and desktop companion app for code review and deployment workflows
